questions.title: Which function type forms a straight line?
questions.explain: Linear functions have the form f(x) = mx + b and create straight lines.

questions.title: Which function forms a parabola?
questions.explain: Quadratic functions have x² and create U-shaped parabolas.

questions.title: Which function forms a V-shape?
questions.explain: Absolute value functions create a sharp V-shaped graph.

questions.title: Which function grows or decays rapidly?
questions.explain: Exponential functions have b^x and grow or decay very fast.

questions.title: Which function has an S-shaped curve?
questions.explain: Cubic functions (x³) create an S-shaped curve with an inflection point.
